name: .204 Cal-39gr Hammer Hunter®
note: Recommended use: Varmint and small game hunting. The product page also says: "This will be a great bullet for varmints small and large. Plenty fast and heavy enough to penetrate on bigger animals like coyote."

Home page: "using only the highest-quality solid copper appropriate for the desired result"; "Because they are pure copper they do not disintegrate like lead core bullets"; "100% Lead Free".
